name: japan-travel
description: Source-backed Japan travel planning, itinerary review and on-demand map/web or presentation handoffs, with read-only destination, weather, transit, seasonal, hotel, rail-pass and restaurant tools.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, review and visualize Japan trips
interface.longDescription: Thirteen skills for Japan travel planning and review, with on-demand interactive map/web guides and presentation handoffs. Covers destinations, weather, rail/bus routes, seasonal viewing, hotels, passes and restaurants. Official source guides curate fourteen destinations; other coverage varies by source. Local HTML generation uses standard-library Python; actual PPTX creation uses the host's authoring tools. Visual resources load only when requested. Anonymous, read-only research with source links and explicit unknowns. No reservations or purchases.
